agents.name: implementer
agents.prompt: Read SPEC.md and test/normalize.test.mjs. Implement normalize.mjs without modifying the spec or tests. Use bash to run node --test test/normalize.test.mjs. Report only observed results.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.prompt: Read SPEC.md and inspect normalize.mjs and test/normalize.test.mjs. Review empty input, types, boundaries, stable ordering, and mutation. Identify defects and missing coverage independently. Do not modify files.
